title: Lime Crema
summary: Sour cream with lime zest and juice. Cool and bright against rich soups and tacos.

steps.title: Zest first
steps.text: Zest the lime before cutting it, then juice it.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the sour cream, zest, juice of one lime, salt, and garlic if using.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Taste. Add more juice for tang, and milk a spoonful at a time to drizzle instead of dollop.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Let it sit so the zest flavors the cream.

notes: The zest carries the lime aroma; the juice mostly adds tang. Stir a minced chipotle into half for a second, smoky crema.
